title: Ralph Wiggum killed programming
summary: Short explainer of a Ralph loop setup with a PRD and progress.txt, built a to-do app autonomously.

assertions.quote: a robust way to let AI autonomously build applications

verdicts.note: Goal/loop features keep agents going through backlogs, but unattended runs drift or game checks without good verification; works when acceptance tests are strong.

assertions.quote: your plan matters a lot. How detailed, how precise ... will dictate the level of quality

verdicts.note: Clear requirements, examples and references reliably improve agent output; the caveat is that bloated context can hurt, so curation matters.

assertions.quote: The progress file tracks what's done

verdicts.note: External notes/memory files are a standard, effective pattern (Anthropic, Manus write-ups) for long tasks; adds retrieval overhead.
